headline: Substitute Ibrahim's volley secures Bangladesh beat Bhutan 1-0 in SAFF opener
summary: Mohammad Ibrahim came off the bench to score the decisive goal, giving Bangladesh a hard-earned victory at the National Stadium in Dhaka.
details: Bangladesh began their SAFF Championship campaign with a 1-0 victory over Bhutan in Dhaka. Substitute Mohammad Ibrahim scored the winning goal with a precise volley in the 65th minute.
The match was largely one-sided, with Bangladesh dominating possession and creating several chances. Faisal Ahmed Fahim and Bishwanath Ghosh both came close to scoring in the first half.
Coach Thomas Dooley made strategic changes in the 63rd minute, replacing captain Jamal Bhuiyan and Bishwanath with Ibrahim and Sohel Rana Jr.
The impact was immediate as Ibrahim swept the ball past goalkeeper Gyeltshen Zangpo just two minutes after entering the game.
This win extends Bangladesh's dominance over Bhutan, with seven victories and one draw from eight meetings in the competition.
Bangladesh will now carry this momentum into their next match against Sri Lanka.

caption:
A super-sub impact! Mohammad Ibrahim scores just two minutes after coming on to lead Bangladesh to victory.

Bangladesh began their SAFF Championship campaign with a 1-0 victory over Bhutan in Dhaka. Substitute Mohammad Ibrahim scored the winning goal with a precise volley in the 65th minute.

The match was largely one-sided, with Bangladesh dominating possession and creating several chances. Faisal Ahmed Fahim and Bishwanath Ghosh both came close to scoring in the first half.

Coach Thomas Dooley made strategic changes in the 63rd minute, replacing captain Jamal Bhuiyan and Bishwanath with Ibrahim and Sohel Rana Jr.

The impact was immediate as Ibrahim swept the ball past goalkeeper Gyeltshen Zangpo just two minutes after entering the game.

This win extends Bangladesh's dominance over Bhutan, with seven victories and one draw from eight meetings in the competition.

Bangladesh will now carry this momentum into their next match against Sri Lanka.

Earlier in the day, India defeated Pakistan 3-2 to start their campaign as the record nine-time champions.

headline_marked: Army soldier [[killed in gunfight with traffickers]] in Teknaf
headline: Army soldier killed in gunfight with traffickers in Teknaf
summary: A 27-year-old soldier died during a joint forces raid against suspected human traffickers in the remote hills of Rangikhali.
details: A soldier of the Bangladesh Army has died following a gunfight between joint forces and suspected human traffickers in Cox’s Bazar’s Teknaf.
The clash occurred in the remote hills of Rangikhali, according to a statement released by the Inter Services Public Relations Directorate (ISPR) on Thursday night.
The deceased has been identified as Mohammad Titas Sheikh, 27, a soldier in the Bangladesh Army.
The incident took place during an anti-trafficking raid conducted by the joint forces in the region.
